mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${backupTableName} AS SELECT * FROM sys_dept

SELECT dept_id, ancestors, org_id FROM sys_dept WHERE org_id = #{orgId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dept SET dept_name = #{deptName}, org_code = #{orgCode}, parent_org_id = #{parentOrgId}, levels = #{levels}, update_time = now() WHERE dept_id = #{deptId}
UPDATE sys_dept SET order_num = CAST(LEFT(org_code, 9) AS INTEGER) WHERE org_code IS NOT NULL AND org_code ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND LENGTH(org_code) > 0

mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dept d SET status = '1', del_flag = '2', update_time = now() WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.dept_id <> 133 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mid_organization m WHERE m.id = d.org_id )
